import hashlib,io,json,os,subprocess,sys,unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()))
from tests import test_gmyhf_padded_tree as tests
results=[]
proof=next(e for e in json.loads(Path('collab/gmyhf-pending-batch14-review.json').read_text())['entries'] if e['global_number']==29663)['authored_reference']
source=proof['source'].split('import sys\nsys.stdout.write')[0]
for name,old,new in [
 ('省略父节点右空位','for child in node[1:]','for child in node[1:2]'),
 ('只移动根节点孩子','levels[::-1]','levels[:1]'),
 ('向左循环','slots[-amount:] + slots[:-amount]','slots[amount:] + slots[:amount]'),
 ('错误循环模数','k % len(slots)','k % (len(slots)+1)'),
 ('删除输出空位',"output.append(str(node[0]) if node else '-1')","output.extend([str(node[0])] if node else [])")]:
 assert source.count(old)==1,name
 ns={};exec(source.replace(old,new),ns)
 with patch.object(tests,'reference',return_value=ns['shift_tree']):
  run=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=io.StringIO()).run(tests.PaddedTreeTests('test_padding_witness_and_bottom_up_order'))
  assert not run.wasSuccessful(),name
 results.append({'mutation':name,'detected':True,'failures':len(run.failures),'errors':len(run.errors)})
cases=[
 ('不修复空根','scripts/gmyhf_review_fixes.py','nodes[0] = 0','nodes[0] = -1','test_repair_changes_only_root_token_and_preserves_legal_bytes'),
 ('改动其他节点','scripts/gmyhf_review_fixes.py',"payload[root.end():]","payload[root.end():].replace(b'2', b'3')",'test_repair_changes_only_root_token_and_preserves_legal_bytes'),
 ('忽略孤立节点','scripts/gmyhf_review_fixes.py','assert slots > 0','assert True','test_repair_rejects_unreachable_nodes_and_invalid_bounds'),
 ('放宽位移上界','scripts/gmyhf_review_fixes.py','k <= 1000','k <= 1001','test_repair_rejects_unreachable_nodes_and_invalid_bounds'),
 ('放宽节点上界','scripts/gmyhf_review_fixes.py','n <= 10001','n <= 10002','test_repair_rejects_unreachable_nodes_and_invalid_bounds'),
 ('忽略节点数','scripts/gmyhf_review_fixes.py','len(values) == n + 2','len(values) >= n + 2','test_repair_rejects_unreachable_nodes_and_invalid_bounds'),
 ('只重算改输入的答案','scripts/repair_gmyhf_review_findings.py','(31415, 31435, 30236, 29663)','(31415, 31435, 30236)','test_prepare_recomputes_unchanged_input_and_binds_confirmed_policy'),
 ('漏写末尾空位说明','scripts/gmyhf_statement_fixes.py','层序输入末尾省略的空孩子也参与循环','末尾空孩子不参与循环','test_statement_adds_only_confirmed_padding_rule')]
for name,path,old,new,test in cases:
 p=Path(path);original=p.read_text()
 try:
  assert original.count(old)==1,(name,original.count(old));p.write_text(original.replace(old,new))
  run=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3.11','-B','-m','unittest','tests.test_gmyhf_padded_tree.PaddedTreeTests.'+test],capture_output=True,env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'))
  assert run.returncode!=0,name
  results.append({'mutation':name,'detected':True,'exit_code':run.returncode})
 finally:p.write_text(original)
s=Path(__file__).read_text();Path('collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch15-mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps({'batch':15,'results':results,'procedure_source':s,'procedure_sha256':hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(len(results),'种变异检出，源码已恢复')
